text: Program Description Stomatologyis to study the mouth organ, facial soft and hard tissue, temporomandibular joint and the pathogenesis of cervical diseases, clinical manifestation, diagnosis, principles and corresponding prevention measures as the main content of the subject. Main purpose is to acquaint students with oral science, the principle of common disease, frequently-occurring disease diagnosis and treatment of the scope of business and the prevention measures, learn the relationship between diseases of oral and maxillofacial region and the whole body, enhance their ability of practical work. Duration 3 years
